Loose metal plate + thin wire (IMG_0668/0669) = Wi-Fi/Bluetooth antenna (plate ZZ89109-1). NO soldering: its U.FL plug snaps onto the round socket just left of the silver Wi-Fi module cover (main-chip side, lower right; IMG_0654 ~x2428 y2193). Press straight down; remove by lifting under the plug, never by the wire.
Syscon (back side, IMG_0670): RENESAS SCEI R9J04G011FP1 (date 1520).
Short check: the 8 small joints first measured = vias (all ~0 to each other, 1 to USB shell). Power input = black connector with the big blade (IMG_0671, front right edge) -> 2 big oval joints on the back (IMG_0670).
